executor_profile.justification: This is a scaffolder-plus-CI-test-plus-schema-field addition against an already-implemented, already-tested `EngineEntry`/`Registry` model — the shape of the scaffolder output, the conformance assertions, and the probation-field semantics are already specified by the absorbed `dod_sketch`es. There is no architectural ambiguity requiring opus-level judgment, and this is registry/schema/CI/scaffold work with no case for an external engine to generate or review it with an advantage.
